zh-CN.name: 无障碍与伦理设计
zh-CN.description: 结合可感知、可操作、可理解等可访问性要求与透明、尊重选择、最少必要数据等设计责任。它是持续检查任务和影响的原则，不是换成大字号或贴一个无障碍标识即可完成。
use_when: 所有产品的核心任务都应考虑不同使用能力。
涉及权限、数据或用户承诺的选择。
avoid_when: 不能只通过自动评分宣布全面合规。
不要用深色模式或大字体替代完整任务检查。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
检查文字对比、键盘路径、语义标签、错误恢复与减少动态效果；让权限和数据用途清楚可见，选择可撤回；覆盖真实辅助技术与不同用户任务，记录仍未解决的障碍。
专属演示：清楚可撤回的偏好选择、默认关闭的可选数据项和键盘焦点，保存只更新本地演示。 参数：正文字号 {font_size_px}px。

en.name: Accessible & Ethical
en.description: A principle combining accessibility needs with transparency, meaningful choice and appropriate data minimization. It requires ongoing checks of tasks and impacts, not just larger type or an accessibility badge.
use_when: Core product tasks must account for varied abilities.
Choices involve permissions, data or user commitments.
avoid_when: Do not declare full compliance from an automated score alone.
Dark mode or larger type cannot replace complete task checks.
en.prompt_template:
Check contrast, keyboard paths, semantic labels, error recovery and reduced motion. Make permissions and data use visible and allow choices to be reversed. Evaluate real assistive technologies and varied user tasks, recording unresolved barriers.
Dedicated demonstration: Clear reversible preference choices, optional data disabled by default and visible keyboard focus; saving changes only the local demo. Parameters: body size {font_size_px}px.
